title: The Punjab Fair Representation of Women Act 2014

sections.shortTitle: The Punjab Fair Representation of Women Act 2014
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

[1]THE PUNJAB FAIR REPRESENTATION
[1][1]THE PUNJAB FAIR REPRESENTATION
OF WOMEN ACT 2014
(Act IV of 2014)
[12 March 2014]
An Act to amend certain laws of the
Punjab
for
purposes of fair representation of women in
decision-making
process and their empowerment.
Whereas it is expedient to amend certain laws of the Punjab for purposes of ensuring fair representation of
women in decision-making bodies and their empowerment;
It
is enacted as follows:-
1. Short title and commencement. (1) This Act may be cited as the Punjab Fair
Representation of Women Act 2014.
(2) It shall come into force at once.
[1][1]This Act
was passed by the Punjab Assembly on 8 March 2014; assented to by the Governor
of the Punjab on 11 March 2014; and, was
published in the Punjab Gazette (Extraordinary), dated 12 March 2014, pages
2733-44.
